description: Three-phase power meter with Modbus RTU: absolute, positive, negative and net energy and power, per-phase values, demand and per-CT configuration
source: DENT Instruments, Operator's Guide PowerScout 3037 Power Meter and ViewPoint Software (November 9, 2017), All Things Modbus

sources.title: Operator's Guide PowerScout 3037 Power Meter and ViewPoint Software
sources.note: All Things Modbus: device, configuration, pulse, absolute, positive, negative and net register tables; table 7 for the data scalars

notes: DENT Instruments PowerScout 3037. Register tables of the 'All Things Modbus' chapter: absolute (44xxx), positive (46xxx), negative (47xxx) and net (44150, 46150, 47150) measurements, device, configuration and pulse port registers. The Veris H8035/H8036 emulation registers (40001...) are not in this map.
The guide numbers registers from 40001 (offset 4000 = register 44001), so this map uses address_base 1 with the register numbers of the guide. Function 03 reads the registers.
All values are unsigned 16-bit. Values that need two registers are LSW first (word order little): value = MSW x 65536 + LSW.

Registers 44001 to 44061 (and the matching positive, negative and net registers) are scaled by the data scalar in register 44602. Scalar 0: kW/kvar/kVA and their energies x 0.00001, amps x 0.01, volts x 0.1. Scalar 1: x 0.001, amps x 0.1, volts x 0.1. Scalar 2: x 0.01, amps x 0.1, volts x 0.1. Scalar 3: x 0.1, amps x 0.1, volts x 0.1. Scalar 4: x 1, amps x 1, volts x 1. Scalar 5: x 10, amps x 1, volts x 1. Scalar 6 or more: x 100, amps x 1, volts x 1. Power factor is always x 0.01.

registers.name: Data scalar
registers.description: 0 to 6; sets the scaling of registers 44001 to 44061 (see notes).

registers.name: Demand window size
registers.description: Default 15 minutes.

registers.name: Volts multiplier integer
registers.description: Volts are multiplied by this value + volts multiplier decimal / 1000, for a step-down transformer.

registers.name: Amps multiplier
registers.description: Multiplies all current values, for x:5 A CTs or one CT on a balanced three-phase load.

registers.name: Communication setting
registers.description: Baud code (900 = 9600, 1900 = 19200, 3800 = 38400, 5700 = 57600, 7600 = 76800, 11500 = 115200) plus parity (00 none, 10 odd, 20 even) plus stop bits (1 or 2). Example: 901 = 9600 baud, no parity, 1 stop bit.

registers.name: Snap to zero threshold, Rogowski CTs
Protocol switch
registers.description: Write 1833 to change to BACnet mode.

registers.name: Volts multiplier decimal
registers.description: Volts are multiplied by volts multiplier integer + this value / 1000.

registers.name: Digital port 1 configuration
registers.description: 0 = no pulses (port is an on/off switch); 44001 = system kWh pulses; 44008 = system kvarh pulses; 44011 = system kVAh pulses.
